Contract ManageStoreCRUDService::modifyStore(id: Integer,name: String,address: String,isopened: Boolean): Boolean {
	definition:
		store: Store = Store.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = id),
		isUpdated: Boolean
	precondition:
		store.oclIsUndefined() = bool
	postcondition:
		let updatedStore: Store in
		updatedStore.oclIsNew() and
		Store.allInstance()->includes(updatedStore) and
		updatedStore.Name = name and
		updatedStore.Address = address and
		updatedStore.IsOpened = isopened and
		result = true
}
